components.name: CommunityGuidelines
components.templateData:
1. Authentic Experiences

We rely on genuine experiences to help others discover great places.

  • Honest Reviews: Only write reviews for businesses you have genuinely interacted with. Do not post fake, compensated, or retaliatory reviews.
  • Accurate Information: Do not create fake businesses or use sock-puppet accounts. Provide accurate location data and operating hours.

2. Respectful Interactions

Treat everyone on Oríta with respect.

  • No Hate Speech or Discrimination: We do not tolerate content that promotes violence, attacks, or demeans individuals or groups based on race, ethnicity, religion, disability, gender, age, or sexual orientation.
  • No Harassment: Do not engage in bullying, stalking, or harassment, either publicly in reviews or privately in direct messages.

3. Safe Discovery

Keep the platform safe for all users.

  • No Illegal Content or Services: Do not use Oríta to promote or sell illegal goods, counterfeit items, or illegal services.
  • No Scams or Fraud: Fraudulent listings and deceptive practices are strictly prohibited.
  • No Spam: Do not post repetitive content, irrelevant promotional material, or unsolicited marketing messages.

4. Protect the Community

Moderation on Oríta is a collaborative effort. We rely on you to help keep the platform clean. Please report:

  • Scams and fraudulent activity.
  • Impersonation of businesses or individuals.
  • Incorrect business information or intentionally misleading location data.
  • Abusive messages or reviews.

5. Enforcement

If we determine that content or an account violates these guidelines, we may remove the content, issue a warning, or suspend the account.

components.name: CookiePolicy
components.templateData:
1. What Are Cookies?

Cookies are small data files that are placed on your computer or mobile device when you visit a website. They are widely used by online service providers to make their websites or services work, or to work more efficiently, as well as to provide reporting information.

2. How We Use Cookies

We currently use cookies primarily for authentication and essential platform functionality. These strictly necessary cookies enable core features such as secure login, maintaining your session while you navigate Oríta, and remembering your preferences.

If we introduce additional analytics or advertising cookies in the future, this policy will be updated accordingly.

3. Types of Cookies We Use

  • Essential/Strictly Necessary Cookies: These cookies are required for the operation of our platform. They include, for example, cookies that enable you to log into secure areas of Oríta.
  • Functional Cookies: These are used to recognize you when you return to our platform. This enables us to personalize our content for you and remember your preferences.

4. Managing Cookies

You have the right to decide whether to accept or reject cookies. You can set or amend your web browser controls to accept or refuse cookies. If you choose to reject cookies, you may still use our platform though your access to some functionality and areas may be restricted.

Since the means by which you can refuse cookies through your web browser controls vary from browser to browser, you should visit your browser's help menu for more information.

components.name: PrivacyPolicy
components.templateData:
1. Information We Collect

We collect information to provide, improve, and protect Oríta. The types of data we collect include:

  • Account Information: When you register, we collect your name, email address, and a hashed version of your password.
  • Business Profile Data: If you create a business on Oríta, we collect the business name, photos, location, operating hours, and contact details.
  • User-Generated Content: This includes reviews, messages, saved lists, and any media you upload.
  • Location Data: We may collect location data when you search for places or businesses. We use mapping and geocoding services to help locate businesses and improve discovery.
  • Activity Data: We collect data about how you interact with the platform, such as your search history, follow relationships, and viewed tours.

2. How We Use Your Information

We use the information we collect to:

  • Provide, personalize, and improve the Oríta discovery experience.
  • Authenticate your account and secure your data.
  • Communicate with you about platform updates, security alerts, and administrative messages.
  • Analyze platform usage to improve features and performance.

3. Information Sharing and Disclosure

Oríta does not sell your personal information or use it for targeted third-party advertising. We may share your information in the following limited circumstances:

  • With Service Providers: We use cloud storage providers to securely store uploaded media and mapping services to provide location features. These providers only have access to the data necessary to perform their functions.
  • Public Content: Information you choose to make public, such as reviews or business profiles, is visible to others.
  • Legal Requirements: We may disclose information if required by law, regulation, or legal process, including the Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDPA) 2023.

4. Your Rights and Choices

You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal information. You can manage your account settings or contact us to exercise these rights.

5. Data Security

We implement technical and organizational measures designed to protect your data. However, no security system is impenetrable, and we cannot guarantee the absolute security of your information.

6. Changes to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. If we make significant changes, we will notify you through the platform or by email.
